meta.name: formax-rolling-plan-loop-workflow
meta.description: Use when the user wants a reusable rolling execution pattern (README + TODO-INDEX) like plans/web-reference-react-refactor, and wants to run delivery in small validated loops.

copy.tagline: 用滚动计划循环执行交付任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在小型验证循环中持续交付计划
copy.tagline_en: Execute delivery tasks in rolling plan loops
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to continuously deliver plans in small validated loops

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在 plans 目录下创建或更新 README.md 和 TODO-INDEX.md，并按照固定循环（实现→定向测试→codex review→提交）逐步推进任务。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求模仿 plans/web-reference-react-refactor 的循环方式，或希望以固定循环推进实现时触发。

say.text: 创建一个新的滚动计划，主题是重构登录模块。
更新当前计划的 TODO-INDEX，只保留未完成项。
say.note: Claude 会清理已完成项并派生下一批任务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will create or update README.md and TODO-INDEX.md in the plans directory, and execute tasks in a fixed loop: implement, targeted test, codex review, commit.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks to mimic the loop pattern of plans/web-reference-react-refactor, or wants to progress implementation in a fixed cycle.

say_en.text: Execute this task following the loop pattern of plans/web-reference-react-refactor.
say_en.note: Claude will create the plan directory and iterate step by step.

say_en.text: Create a new rolling plan for refactoring the login module.
say_en.note: Claude will generate README and TODO-INDEX.

say_en.text: Update the TODO-INDEX of the current plan, keeping only incomplete items.
say_en.note: Claude will clean completed items and derive next batch.
